name: kungfuchess
description: Real-time Kung Fu Chess - server, clients and shared libraries.

gui.description: Dependencies for the OpenCV-based graphical client (KungFuChessGUI). On by default so a plain `cmake -S . -B build` builds the same set of projects as KungFuChess.sln; switch it off with --no-default-features (see the 'headless' preset) for server-only builds.
